card.name: Linking words after a death or disaster
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, and, during, a comma) right after a death, disaster or accident has been described, where the text is likely to continue with grief, mourning or an investigation.

card.writes: It pushes toward words of grief, mourning and investigation, and away from words about challenge or proportions.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words after a death or disaster, when the text is about to speak of grief or an inquiry.
